subject.title: fix(agents): xAI/Grok requests fail after a stale reasoning replay ("could not decrypt encrypted_content")

question: Should maintainers accept pre-fix production logs plus positive/negative predicate tests as sufficient proof for this non-inducible xAI stale encrypted_content rotation, or keep requiring organic after-fix xAI/Grok recovery evidence before merge?
rationale: ClawSweeper cannot mark the proof sufficient automatically because the PR does not show after-fix real behavior, but the contributor plausibly explains that the exact provider-side rotation cannot be forced on demand.

options.title: Require explicit proof override
options.body: Keep the PR blocked unless a maintainer records a proof override for this provider-owned trigger or the contributor later adds organic redacted after-fix logs.

options.title: Accept current evidence as sufficient
options.body: Treat the pre-fix production logs and focused tests as enough for this narrow predicate change and proceed with normal merge review after current-base refresh.

options.title: Wait for organic after-fix proof
options.body: Leave the PR waiting until a future xAI/Grok rotation produces redacted logs showing the patched retry succeeds.

recommendation.title: Require explicit proof override
recommendation.body: Keep the PR blocked unless a maintainer records a proof override for this provider-owned trigger or the contributor later adds organic redacted after-fix logs.

likelyOwner.reason: This person handled the adjacent merged retry change and its similar provider-generated proof limitation, making them the best available routing owner for proof sufficiency.
